scientific_integrity: Universal claims are supported by an explicit analytical proof; the bundled deterministic checks are finite illustrations. The study does not claim independent validation or settle all publication-priority uncertainty.
scientific_limitations: Exact circular Poisson kernel, independent re-randomization of whole trapezoidal grids, and the near-boundary regime \(r^N\) tending to one. No assertion for arbitrary integrands, reused shifts, finite-precision cost, or uniform Sobolev classes. Classical Fourier aliasing and standard Poisson-process limit tools are prior knowledge.
title: Sharp sampling crossover for independently shifted near-boundary Poisson quadrature
